primitives.name: Neural Network Performance Predictor
primitives.verbatim_quote: We employ neural networks to predict each cricketer's performance in the future based upon their past performance.
primitives.assumptions: Performance follows a non-linear temporal pattern; historical data is representative of future behavior.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When P_past contains insufficient variance or is outdated beyond model training horizon.

layer2.mapping: Maps input performance history to latent feature space for classification into performer/moderate/failure tiers.
layer2.telemetry: Mean squared error between predicted and actual performance in test set.

primitives.name: Cricketer Performance Classification
primitives.verbatim_quote: We classify cricketers into three categories – performer, moderate and failure.
primitives.assumptions: Performance categories are mutually exclusive and collectively exhaustive.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When classification boundaries become ambiguous due to overlapping performance distributions.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to discrete state-space partitioning in machine learning classification tasks.
layer2.telemetry: Accuracy of classification against ground truth labels from World Cup data.

primitives.name: Heuristic Team Selection Rule
primitives.verbatim_quote: Based on the ratings generated and by applying heuristic rules we recommend cricketers to be included in the World Cup 2007.
primitives.assumptions: Team composition is optimized under constraints of role balance and rating thresholds.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When heuristic thresholds fail to accommodate emergent team dynamics or player availability.

layer2.mapping: Applies binary logic to transform continuous ratings into discrete team inclusion decisions.
layer2.telemetry: Number of recommended players selected in actual World Cup squad.
